paragraphs: LocalHop sells library software that puts event programming, room reservations, calendars and activity passes in one system. On the room reservation side, patrons book rooms themselves and staff get automated confirmations, buffer times and PIN door access. The calendar product publishes once across all branches, and activity passes let a library card reach local venues and cultural experiences.

The case studies name public libraries, academic institutions and statewide networks, including East Baton Rouge Parish Library and Rochester Hills Public Library. A county parks department is there as well, in a website project for Genesee County Parks & Recreation. Their pages describe single branches and multi-location systems in urban, suburban and rural communities.

Founded in 2015 in Pontiac, Michigan, the company started as a free events app before libraries became its market. The about page describes a platform built exclusively for public libraries, with 70+ custom ILS integrations and ten years in the market.

quote.text: Born by libraries. Built for the community.
